records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter and first six months of FY’22, subscription support revenues increased 17% (22% constant currency) and 18% (21% constant currency), respectively, and cloud revenues grew by 23% (25% constant currency) and 34% (35% constant currency, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Q2’22 ARR increased to $1.53 billion, representing 11% growth (13% on a constant currency basis) compared to Q2’21, driven by strength in new bookings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Q2’22 revenue of $505 million was up 9% (13% constant currency) over Q2’21, driven by higher revenue from our recurring revenue business lines, particularly in Digital Thread where contract durations on on-premise subscriptions increased over Q2’21.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Q2’22 operating margin was 32% compared to 22% in Q2’21, and Q2’22 non-GAAP operating margin was 42% compared to 37% in Q2’21.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Discontinuing our operations in Russia during Q2’22 had an immaterial effect on our on revenue, operating margins, EPS and cash flows.
